description: Check up to 500 lines against one South African National Lottery draw. Returns matches and the prize division per line for that draw. Uses 1 API call PER LINE (up to 500). Only use this when the user explicitly has more than 10 lines; otherwise use check_lottery_numbers, which costs 1 call for up to 10 lines.

game.description: South African game. Daily Lotto Plus, Lotto Plus 2 and Powerball Plus only for draws before 2026-06-01.

lines.description: One line (array of numbers) or several lines (array of arrays). Lotto games: 6 numbers. Powerball games: 5 main numbers then the Powerball as the 6th. Daily Lotto: 5 numbers.

name: bulk_check_lottery_numbers
title: Bulk check lottery numbers
